comments.author: @GlobeLifeHidden
comments.text: Imagine catching a huge fish- and being expected to share it with the entire community. Would you do it? yes or no?

comments.author: @ThompsonRyan-u4h
comments.text: Just got back from catching tuna and helped divide the haul at the village Inati center! On Tokelau, no one sells fish—every catch is shared equally among every family on the atoll. Powered 100% by solar and waiting for fortnightly supply boats from Samoa, could you handle living where money literally can’t buy your dinner? 🇹🇰
